description: PeakCam's 0–100 Snow Score for one resort, scored once a day by a fixed formula (scoredBy is always `algorithmic`): `today` carries the score, its four-tier rating (great ≥ 75, good ≥ 55, fair ≥ 35, else poor; the same words as the conditions rating), a dated tagline to quote and five components, each with points, max, a one-line basis and its source: depth vs the station's 1991–2020 normal (30), new snow over the last 7 days (25), the blended 7-day forecast (20), snow quality from days since snow, the 3-day high and the surface tags (15), and the operating status (10). `history` is one point per scored day over the last 30 days. Use it for "how good is X right now and why", "score X out of 100", "is X better than last week"; for a ranking use find_powder, compare_resorts or /api/v1/snow-report?sort=score. `available: false` before the first scoring run.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

name: get_score

available.description: False when the scorer has not written a row for this resort yet (or the table is not served).

history.description: One point per scored day over the trailing window, oldest first.

ladder.description: Score at or above each cutoff earns the label; below `fair` is `poor`.

pageUrl.description: Where the score ring and sparkline render.

sentence.description: The dated tagline, or why there is no score.

depthVsNormal.description: 30: snowpack against the station's 1991–2020 median (SWE); without a normal, base depth on a fixed scale capped at 27.

basis.description: One line saying what the points rest on, quotable as is.

max.description: The component's weight; the five maximums add to 100.

forecast7d.description: 20: the blended next-7-day forecast total (20 in is full marks).

basis.description: One line saying what the points rest on, quotable as is.

max.description: The component's weight; the five maximums add to 100.

operatingStatus.description: 10: OPEN full, PRE_SEASON and CLOSED_TODAY half, OFF_SEASON and UNKNOWN none.

basis.description: One line saying what the points rest on, quotable as is.

max.description: The component's weight; the five maximums add to 100.

recentSnow7d.description: 25: measured or modelled new snow over the last 7 days (24 in is full marks).

basis.description: One line saying what the points rest on, quotable as is.

max.description: The component's weight; the five maximums add to 100.

snowQuality.description: 15: days since the last snow day × the 3-day high temperature × the engine's surface tags.

basis.description: One line saying what the points rest on, quotable as is.

max.description: The component's weight; the five maximums add to 100.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the score is for (Mountain-time day of the scoring run).

rating.description: The score's four-tier label: great ≥ 75, good ≥ 55, fair ≥ 35, else poor.

scoredBy.description: Always `algorithmic`: a fixed function of measured and modelled inputs, never an editorial call.

tagline.description: Dated sentence to quote: the score, its rating and the components strongest first.

version.description: Formula version, e.g. `score-v1`; a change re-scores the history.

today.description: The newest score at most 3 days old, else null.

title: Snow Score
